title: Vision Vendor Matching API Contract v1
description: REST API for triggering/reading solicitation-scoped vendor matching. Extends backend/api/routes/solicitations.py — same router, same auth, same manager (SolicitationManager.update for status columns) plus a new VendorMatchManager for vendor_matches rows.

VendorMatch.description: A single ranked vendor_matches row joined with read-only vendor contact/capability fields for display. contact_email is null if it equals the vendors table's known sentinel string ('The business owner has hidden this information from public searches') — never surfaced as a real address.

contact_email.description: Null if sentinel-masked in the source vendors row.

vendor_matching_trigger.summary: Manually (re)trigger vendor matching for a solicitation. Requires triage_status='complete' and quick_kill=false. Deletes prior vendor_matches rows for this solicitation before the job runs (CLAIM-08 — enforced by the job handler at save-time, not by this endpoint).

400.description: Triage not complete, quick-killed, no NAICS code, or matching already running
400.notes: detail is one of: 'Cannot run vendor matching — triage has not completed', 'Cannot run vendor matching — solicitation was quick-killed during triage', 'Cannot run vendor matching — solicitation has no NAICS code', 'Vendor matching is already running'.

vendor_matches_list.summary: Get ranked vendor matches for a solicitation, joined with vendor contact/capability fields, ordered by rank ascending. Also returns the solicitation's matching status and outreach email template so the tab can render in one call.

200.description: Matching status + ranked matches + outreach template

outreach_email_body.description: Contains {{vendor_name}} and {{match_reason}} placeholders for client-side substitution.

vendor_matches_list.notes: Returns 200 with matching_status='pending' and matches=[] before the first run — not a 404. The frontend distinguishes 'not started' from 'no results found' via matching_status, not via an empty array alone (matches=[] with matching_status='complete' is a legitimate zero-candidate outcome).

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid Bearer token

409.description: Not used by this contract — 400 is used instead for state-conflict cases (matching already running), matching the existing 409 reserved for triage's own 'already running' response in solicitations.py's docstring convention being 409 there; vendor-matching uses 400 per CLAIM-06's verdict wording.

422.description: Validation error — request body/path failed Pydantic/FastAPI validation

designNotes.flow: 1) run_solicitation_triage() (solicitation_triage.py) completes with quick_kill=false -> auto-enqueues job_type='vendor_matching' (CLAIM-05, mirrors sam_fetch->solicitation_triage chain in worker.py) with metadata={'solicitation_id': id}. 2) Worker's process_vendor_matching_job() calls run_vendor_matching_pipeline(case_id, solicitation_id) in vendor_matching.py. 3) Pipeline builds a deterministic SQL candidate pool (NAICS exact -> NAICS family -> capabilities FTS union, set-aside hard-gated, capped ~300 rows per Brief §6), then a single LLM agent ranks/selects top 25 + drafts one outreach template. 4) Pipeline deletes existing vendor_matches for solicitation_id, inserts up to 25 new rows, writes outreach_email_subject/body and matching_status='complete' onto solicitations. 5) Client calls GET .../vendor-matches (polling while matching_status='running', same pattern as TriageTab.tsx).
designNotes.manualTriggerGating: Mirrors POST /api/solicitations/{id}/triage's structure exactly (mgr.get -> validate -> mgr.update(matching_status='pending') -> enqueue job) but adds triage_status/quick_kill/naics_code preconditions absent from the triage trigger, since vendor matching is a downstream stage.
designNotes.noNewVendorEndpoint: GET /api/vendors (global directory search, VendorsTab.tsx) is untouched. This contract only adds solicitation-scoped endpoints under /api/solicitations/{id}/...; vendor_matches rows are read via VendorMatchManager, a new class alongside SolicitationManager in core/solicitation.py or a new core/vendor_match.py module (implementation's choice in State 4, per Brief §5 Element list).
designNotes.outreachTemplateOwnership: outreach_email_subject/body live on solicitations (one shared template per solicitation, not per vendor_matches row) per Brief §7 explicit scope decision — no per-vendor email columns exist anywhere in this contract.
